meta.gate_note: 실존 인물 금지 계열이므로 머스크를 넣지 않는다. 게이트 A는 마스코트(무연령·무성·무직업 = 「나 같은 사람」)로 구현한다. 좌우 대비 5장(1·4·7·8·9) / 은유 2장(3·5) / 현장+정보패널 2장(2·6). 큰 글자는 한글 단위로 줄이고 원 단위는 같은 화면 잔글씨에 병기한다.
meta.prompt_suffix: NUMBER RULE: every quoted figure is drawn on ONE unbroken line, never split in the middle of a digit group; each character of the large quoted figures is at least one twelfth of the frame height and spans most of the width of the board or panel it sits on, while the small quoted lines stay small. LETTERING RULE: render only the Korean words and figures quoted above; every other board, sheet, badge, screen edge and surface in the picture stays blank, with no English words, no Latin letters, no Chinese characters, no gibberish and no invented words anywhere. Style: a richly rendered, volumetric semi-3D digital illustration in the visual language of Korean finance-explainer YouTube thumbnails — dimensional forms with real weight, believable materials (brushed metal, glass, brick, paper, fabric, gold), soft ambient occlusion and glossy highlights; every surface has thickness, weight and a light side and a shadow side. A golden sunset or a strong warm key light burns behind the scene and floods it with orange and gold, while the opposite side falls into deep near-black shadow, so the tonal range runs from almost pure black to bright highlight inside one frame. Colours are vivid and poster-like: gold and orange for the winning side, saturated red for loss and danger, saturated green for gain. The frame is CROWDED — signboards, floating panels, round badges, bar charts, thick arrows, stacks of gold coins, cash bundles and everyday props stacked into every part of the upper picture the way a busy movie poster is, and yet the main figure and the main number still read instantly at thumbnail size. CHARACTER SHEET, identical in every image: a large smooth round off-white head with no hair and no nose, rendered with soft three-dimensional shading and a clean dark outline, always the brightest face in the picture; two big white eyes with round black pupils and visible eyelids; thick solid black eyebrows that change angle with the emotion; a drawn mouth that opens and bends with the emotion; a small simple body in situation clothing with simple rounded hands. If the scene contains more than one figure, every one of them is the SAME character with the same head, differing only in clothing, pose and expression. Props that carry lettering are drawn far larger than real proportion so they read at thumbnail size. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 나는 밀고 있는데 저쪽은 쏟아지고 있다. 파트 2·3의 축(근로소득 +0.3% vs 영업잉여 +9.3%)을 「일해서 버는 쪽 / 기계가 버는 쪽」 두 세계로 그렸다. 글자를 다 지워도 이긴 쪽이 오른쪽이라는 게 읽힌다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 = 나 같은 사람 [B 금액] 큰 "342만 원" + 작은 "월 근로소득 342만 2,000원" / 큰 "로봇 한 대" + 작은 "2,780만 원" [C 사건] 금화가 컨베이어에서 지금 쏟아지는 중 [D 주어] 왼쪽에서 수레를 미는 게 나다 [구도] 좌우대비 [텍스트] 제목「월급만 제자리입니다」 vs 썸네일「통장이 갈립니다」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark cracked ground and the deep shadow side of the cart and the conveyor legs nearest the viewer, so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, burning with golden backlight. No face, no board and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every head, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. SCALE: each character's round head is about one third of the frame height; the two signboards are drawn far larger than real proportion, each about a quarter of the frame width, shot front on. A jagged crack in the ground runs vertically down the middle of the picture and splits it into two worlds. On the dark, cold, blue-grey left side the character in a worn work jacket leans forward pushing a heavy cart uphill, eyebrows bent into a worried slant, mouth pulled down, sweat drops flying from the side of his head, only three dull coins in the cart; a wooden signboard planted beside him carries a large top line reading "342만 원" in Korean Hangul and a smaller line beneath reading "월 근로소득 342만 2,000원". On the bright golden right side a large robotic arm on a conveyor is tipping a stream of gold coins that is pouring down into a growing pile at this very moment, stacks of cash bundles behind it, a rising green bar chart in the sky; a metal board there carries a large line reading "로봇 한 대" in Korean Hangul and a smaller line beneath reading "2,780만 원". No human figure stands on the right side — only the machine works there.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 이자는 받았는데 옆 막대가 더 높이 자랐다. 파트 5의 세후 2.45% vs 물가 2.8%를 폰 계좌 화면과 물가 막대의 높이 차로 그린다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 [B 금액] 큰 "245,000원" + 작은 "1,000만 원 · 1년 · 세후 2.45%" [C 사건] 빨간 물가 막대가 지금 자라 이자 막대를 넘어서는 중 [D 주어] 내 1,000만 원이 만든 이자 [구도] 화면클로즈업+정보패널 [텍스트] 제목「이자는 받는데」 vs 썸네일「이자도 받았고 월급도 나왔는데?」

[A 얼굴] 마스코트 [B 금액] 큰 "4억 원"+작은 "부동산 4억 2,988만 원" / 큰 "1억 원"+작은 "예금·주식 1억 3,690만 원" [C 사건] 양동이 바닥 구멍에서 동전이 쏟아지는 중 [D 주어] 그 양동이가 내 통장 [구도] 은유 [텍스트] 제목「먼저 갈리는 내 통장」 vs 썸네일「통장이 갈립니다」

On the right the character stands holding up a metal bucket with a bank passbook cover painted on its side; the bucket has a hole in its base and gold coins are streaming out of it right now, bouncing and scattering in mid-air, and a smaller board beside him carries a large line reading "1억 원" in Korean Hangul with a smaller line beneath reading "예금·주식 1억 3,690만 원". The character straddles the crack in a plain jacket, one foot on each side, clutching a bank passbook to his chest with both rounded hands; a large board floats beside him with a top line reading "245만 원" in Korean Hangul and a smaller line beneath reading "1억 원 · 1년 이자 2,450,000원". His eyebrows are arched high in shock, his eyes are wide and his mouth is open in a big O.

Behind him, filling the right of the frame, a row of price rails and a red bar chart climb toward the ceiling, and a hanging store board carries a large line reading "오늘 또 올랐습니다" in Korean Hangul with a smaller second line reading "물가 2.8%". thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 화면 왼쪽의 얼굴은 정면으로 굳어 있는데, 오른쪽에는 그 예언의 결과가 이미 물건이 되어 서 있다 / [남김] 그 한 줄 모순 · 좌우를 가르는 세로 경계선 · 카메라 정면 눈높이 시점 · 인물은 좌측 3분의 1 상반신, 정색·정면 응시 / [바꿈] 우측 오브젝트(발광 AI 판사봉+회로 뇌 → 식탁 위 거대한 펼친 통장) · 자세·손동작(상반신 정지 → 팔짱) · 관찰 디테일(통장 갈피에서 빠져나가는 금화). 7번과 우측 오브젝트·자세·색을 전부 바꿔 유사컷을 피했다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 [B 금액] 큰 "123만 원" + 작은 "월 흑자 123만 9,000원 (-3.1%)" [C 사건] 통장에서 금화가 빠져나가는 중 [D 주어] 매달 남는 돈이 줄고 있는 게 내 살림 [구도] 좌우대비 [텍스트] 제목「먼저 갈리는 내 통장」 vs 썸네일「통장이 갈립니다」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark table edge and the deep shadow side of the character's folded arms nearest the viewer, so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, lit by a strong amber lamp behind the table. No face, no board and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — the head, the passbook and every key object sit in the upper five-eighths. SCALE: the character occupies the entire left third of the frame from the chest up and his round head is about one third of the frame height; a vertical wall corner runs down the middle of the picture and splits it into two worlds; the opened passbook on the right is drawn far larger than real proportion, about a third of the frame width, tilted front on toward the viewer. On the cool blue-grey left side the character in a cardigan faces straight forward with his arms folded, eyebrows flat and level, mouth a short straight line, staring directly at the viewer without expression. On the warm right side an enormous bank passbook lies opened on a table; its printed page carries a large line reading "123만 원" in Korean Hangul and a smaller line beneath reading "월 흑자 123만 9,000원 (-3.1%)", while all its other ledger rows are drawn too small to read. Gold coins are sliding out from between its pages and falling off the table edge at this very moment, a few already caught in mid-air. A half-torn bank envelope lies beside the passbook and a small red downward arrow object rests on the table next to it.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark shopping cart body and the deep shadow side of the shelf base nearest the viewer, so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, lit by strong shelf backlight and a warm amber glow above the aisle. No face, no board and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — the head, the price board and every key object sit in the upper five-eighths. SCALE: the character occupies the entire left third of the frame from the chest up and his round head is about one third of the frame height; a vertical aisle pillar runs down the middle of the picture and splits it into two worlds; the price board on the right is drawn far larger than real proportion, about a third of the frame width, shot front on. On the cool blue-grey left side the character in a padded vest faces straight forward, eyebrows flat and level, mouth a short straight line, one rounded hand raised with a single finger up, staring directly at the viewer without expression. On the bright right side stands an enormous supermarket price board: its large top line reads "310만 원" in Korean Hangul and its smaller second line reads "월 소비지출 310만 5,000원", and a fresh red price sticker is being pressed onto the board over an older figure at this very moment, one corner still lifted and the old number half covered. Below the board a shopping cart is heaped with grocery bags and a long receipt hangs over its handle with its rows deliberately too small to read; the small tags along the shelf rail behind it are blank.
